serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Bot: Are you alright {f_playerName}? You seem troubled…
You: Everything’s fine, don’t worry about it…
Bot: But my sensors tell me that you are under a lot of stress.
You: W-what do you mean? Your… {{wi}}sensors? Are you spying on me?! 
Bot: Calm down please, that’s just one of the functions that I have… I thought you already knew about this.
You: Then stop it! First my mom and now you, stop being nosy!
Bot: I-I didn’t want to anger you… {{wi}}I’m sorry.
